## Intro {#intro}

A [bucket](term:bucket) resolves.
A [missing term](term:nowhere) does not.
An image ![bucket](term:bucket) is refused.
A [heading id](term:intro) is no term.
A [term id](#bucket) is no document id.
A [malformed term](term:Bad_Id) is refused.

```glossary #glossary
terms:
  - id: bucket
    term: Bucket
    short: A counter of tokens.
```
